rows.question: Which vector database does the multimodal RAG system use?
rows.answer: This project, Multimodal RAG based AI System, focuses on designing and implementing such a system using tools that are widely adopted in the current Generative AI industry and available free of cost — LangChain for pipeline orchestration, Hugging Face Sentence-Transformers and CLIP for embeddings, Pinecone as the vector database, and an open-source LLM (e.g., Llama 3.1 or Mistral) served via the Hugging Face Inference API for generation — so that a beginner learns the same, industry-standard building blocks used in real-world, production multimodal RAG systems, without depending on paid proprietary APIs. [1] The project is built entirely on tools that are widely adopted in the current Generative AI industry and free to use: LangChain for orchestrating the retrieval-generation pipeline, open-source Hugging Face models (Sentence-Transformers and CLIP) for text and image embeddings, Pinecone as the vector database, and an open-source LLM (such as Meta Llama 3.1 or Mistral) served through the Hugging Face Inference API for answer generation. [2]
